name: Haltern am See (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Haltern am See (a white knotted band on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Haltern am See; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Haltern arms — white knotted band on blue
